note: The ring builder's options. One plain reason per option, no price anywhere. The house replaces every line before launch.

options.label: Solitaire
options.why: One stone held by claws. The most light reaches it.

options.label: Halo
options.why: Small stones circle the centre one, so it reads larger.

options.label: Three stone
options.why: A stone either side of the centre. Three moments in one ring.

options.label: Bezel
options.why: A rim of metal holds the stone. The safest for every day.

options.label: Blue sapphire
options.why: The Ceylon stone. Shown to you in daylight before anything else.

options.label: Pink sapphire
options.why: Softer in colour and rarer on the table.

options.label: Yellow sapphire
options.why: Warm and at home in yellow gold.

options.label: Spinel
options.why: Often taken for sapphire. Its own stone, with its own report.

size.label: Size
size.ask: Roughly how large a centre stone.

options.label: Under 1 carat
options.why: Quiet on the hand and easy to wear every day.

options.label: 1 to 2 carats
options.why: Clearly a centre stone without taking over the hand.

options.label: Over 2 carats
options.why: Noticed across a room. Fewer on the table at a time.

options.label: Not sure yet
options.why: A specialist shows you sizes side by side on a call.

options.label: Rose gold
options.why: Softer and it suits a pink stone.

options.label: White gold
options.why: Lets the stone carry all the colour.

options.label: Platinum
options.why: Heavier and harder wearing than gold.

options.label: Set with small stones
options.why: Small stones along the band catch the light with the centre one.
